prize: Each age-group winner (2–4, 5–6, 7–8) receives a children's book bundle worth up to US$50 plus a printable winner's certificate. Prize packs grow with sponsor and donor support.

themes.title: My Snowy Day
themes.brief: Draw, build or tell a story about a snowy (or rainy!) winter day.

themes.title: Kindness Cards
themes.brief: Make a card for someone who has been kind to you, and tell us why.

themes.title: Letter Monsters
themes.brief: Turn a letter of the alphabet into a creature. What sound does it make?

themes.title: Rainbow Hunt
themes.brief: Find or make something in every color of the rainbow.

themes.title: Garden Bugs
themes.brief: Draw or build a bug you found (or invented). Where does it live?

themes.title: Under the Sea
themes.brief: Create an ocean scene or a sea creature with a name and a story.

themes.title: Space Explorers
themes.brief: Design a rocket, a planet or an alien friend and tell us about the trip.

themes.title: My Favorite Animal
themes.brief: Show your favorite animal and three facts about it.

themes.title: First Day of School
themes.brief: Draw or write about starting school, a new class or a new friend.

themes.title: Autumn Leaves
themes.brief: Make art with leaves, or count and sort a leaf collection.

themes.title: Thank You, Helpers
themes.brief: Celebrate a community helper — a nurse, teacher, firefighter or neighbor.

themes.title: Winter Wonderland Story
themes.brief: Tell a winter story in pictures or words. Grown-ups can write it down.
